project.title: Launch of New Subscription-Based Product Line
project.objective: Plan and execute the launch of a new subscription-based product line to grow recurring revenue and improve customer retention.
deliverables: Validated subscription product value proposition and pricing model
Go-to-market launch plan with channels, budget and timeline
Customer journey and experience blueprint for subscription lifecycle
KPI framework and dashboard for tracking subscription performance
Operational playbook covering quality control, billing and support
Post-launch performance review and optimization plan
constraints: Launch must occur within 21 days from project start
Total launch budget capped at predefined marketing and ops limits
Must comply with internal financial reporting and approval rules
Customer communications must follow brand and legal guidelines
Existing billing and CRM systems must be reused, no new platforms
Quality control checks required before any public announcement

risks.risk: Subscription offer does not resonate with target customers, leading to low sign-ups.
risks.mitigation: Run quick concept tests and pricing surveys with target segments before finalizing offer.

risks.risk: Operational processes for billing and support are not ready at launch.
risks.mitigation: Create and test end-to-end process flows and checklists; run pilot with limited audience first.

risks.risk: Budget overruns due to last-minute marketing or operational changes.
risks.mitigation: Lock baseline scope early, track spend weekly, and require approvals for any scope changes.

risks.risk: Data quality issues in KPI tracking cause wrong decisions post-launch.
risks.mitigation: Align on KPI definitions, run data validation before launch, and cross-check with finance reports.

themes.why_relevant: Defines why customers should subscribe and at what price point to hit revenue targets.
Ensures coordinated launch across channels within budget and timeline constraints.
Impacts conversion, retention and perceived value of the subscription product.
Enables data-driven decisions on scaling, optimizing or pivoting the offer.
Multiple departments must align on processes, budgets and quality standards.

backlog.task: Define target segments, value proposition and subscription tiers
definition_of_done: Target segments documented with key needs and behaviors
Value proposition statement approved by department manager
Subscription tiers and benefits list finalized and shared

backlog.task: Develop pricing and discount strategy for subscription plans
definition_of_done: Pricing model documented with assumptions and margin analysis
Discount rules and promo windows defined and approved by finance manager
Pricing scenarios reviewed with department manager
Launch objectives and KPIs defined and agreed
Channel mix, budget allocation and timeline documented
Dependencies with operations and customer service identified and scheduled

backlog.task: Design end-to-end customer journey for subscription lifecycle
definition_of_done: Customer journey map created from awareness to renewal/cancellation
Key touchpoints and ownership per department defined
Pain points and quality control checkpoints documented

backlog.task: Prepare marketing campaign assets and messaging
definition_of_done: Core messaging and creative brief approved
List of required assets (emails, landing pages, in-app messages) finalized
Asset production timeline aligned with launch date

backlog.task: Define KPI framework and reporting cadence
definition_of_done: List of core KPIs (sign-ups, churn, ARPU, CAC) agreed
Data sources and calculation rules documented
Reporting cadence and owners defined and shared

backlog.task: Align budget, approvals and financial tracking
definition_of_done: Budget breakdown by activity and department documented
Approval from finance manager recorded
Tracking method for actual vs budget agreed

backlog.task: Document operational processes for billing and support
definition_of_done: Process flows for billing, renewals and cancellations documented
Customer service scripts and escalation paths drafted
Dry-run of processes completed with no critical gaps

backlog.task: Set up and validate KPI dashboard
definition_of_done: Dashboard structure created with agreed KPIs
Test data loaded and validated against finance reports
Access granted to relevant stakeholders

backlog.task: Run pre-launch readiness review and quality checks
definition_of_done: Checklist-based review completed across marketing, ops and support
Critical issues logged and owners assigned
Go/no-go decision documented with rationale

backlog.task: Execute launch and monitor first-week performance
definition_of_done: Launch activities executed as per plan
Daily performance updates shared during first week
Any major deviations from plan documented and addressed

backlog.task: Conduct post-launch review and define optimization backlog
definition_of_done: Post-launch performance vs KPIs analyzed
Key learnings and issues documented
Prioritized list of optimization initiatives created

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on subscription value proposition, tiers and pricing approach.
threads_plan.trigger: Kickoff message starting the project and asking for alignment on product brief and pricing.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve target segments and core value proposition for the subscription product.
Select the initial subscription tiers and pricing bands to model in detail.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Lock the go-to-market launch plan, channels and budget allocation.
threads_plan.trigger: Department manager shares first draft of the go-to-market plan and budget split.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the final channel mix and launch timeline.
Confirm budget allocation per channel within the overall cap.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Finalize customer journey, operational processes and readiness checklist.
threads_plan.trigger: Product manager posts draft customer journey and operational playbook for review.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree on the final customer journey and key quality checkpoints.
Approve the pre-launch readiness checklist for go/no-go review.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Define KPI framework, dashboard spec and reporting cadence.
threads_plan.trigger: Product manager shares proposed KPI list and dashboard structure for feedback.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Confirm the core KPIs and their definitions for tracking launch performance.
Agree on reporting cadence and owners for post-launch monitoring.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Coordinate launch week execution and capture early results and learnings.
threads_plan.trigger: Day-before-launch message to sync on go/no-go status and launch-day actions.

channel_rituals: Daily async launch standup during the week before and after launch
Weekly KPI review post with dashboard snapshot and key insights
Pre-launch go/no-go checklist review 24 hours before launch
Post-launch retrospective thread one week after launch
Mid-project alignment check at the end of week one
